lead: Charlie Kirk was an American conspiracy theorist, born on 14 October 1993 in Arlington Heights.
He died on 10 September 2025 in Timpanogos Regional Hospital at the age of 31.
He has held the office of chief executive officer of Turning Point USA and has been recognised with Forbes 30 Under 30 and Silver Play Button.
This profile collects the Charlie facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.
